heading: Official communications.
text: No public officer shall be compelled to disclose communications made to him in official confidence, when he considers that the public interests would suffer by the disclosure. 1. Subs. by Act 13 of 2013, s. 27 for s. 119 (w.e.f. 3-2-2013).
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
